units.text: Attraction runs high today, and people notice you more than usual. Glances and easy talk find you without much effort on your part.
Tense moments today soften before they grow, and harsh words lose their edge. The day asks little of your nerves.
Help comes from someone with standing, an elder or a near stranger who owes you nothing. Taking it asks you to set your pride aside.
The day moves you, with travel, an errand across town or a change of place. Your plans stretch to fit the distance.
A setback today carries something useful inside it. Reaching it takes your work, not luck.
Today the day lands on the same gate the month already presses, and your home carries both loads at once.
Your plans for later and the young people near you carry the month's pull and the day's at once, on the same gate.
The pressure the month has put on your work comes to a head today, because the day lands on the same gate.
On the gate of your first home, the day lands where the month already presses, doubling the strain you carry.
A small plan with a partner or the people you live with comes together easily today. Your evening at home asks for your time over your errands.
Someone younger seeks you out today, for help or simply to be near you. A plan for later firms up as well, and it asks for your word.
Work pulls together today, and a colleague who kept apart joins your side. A stalled task starts moving again, and it asks you to keep pace with it.
Someone from the home you grew up in reaches out, with a call, a message or an old family joke. A reply asks for an hour of your day and a little of your guard.
A plan at home changes at short notice, with a partner or whoever you live with. Giving it up costs you the evening you had set aside.
Something you promised for later gets pushed back, a date with someone younger or a step in a long plan. The delay costs you a piece of their trust and your own timetable.
A plan you settled at work comes loose, and someone asks you to defend it. Defending it takes time and patience you had meant for other tasks.
News from the family you grew up in changes a plan without warning, a visit moved or a date dropped. Rearranging around it takes a slice of your week.
Home gathers strength, with a partner or the people you live with pulling the same way. Shared chores go faster with every pair of hands, your own included.
Younger people gather round your ideas, and a long plan picks up speed. Something you set going a while back now asks for your steering.
Momentum builds at work, and people line up behind a task you care about. Leading it today asks for more of your hours than you had set aside.
Relatives from your first home gather round in person or by message, and old ties pull tight again. Their eyes turn to you as the one at the centre.
A small thing at home is misread, a look or a tone a partner takes differently from how you meant it. The evening loses some of its ease while the doubt sits with you.
A young person you guide feels passed over, or a plan for later loses a little of its shine. Noticing the quiet change takes your full attention.
A colleague takes a word of yours the wrong way, and the air at work cools a little. Clearing it costs you a plain conversation you would rather skip.
A remark from an older relative lands wrong, though nobody meant it unkindly. It stings more than its size, and the sting stays with you through the day.
An old argument at home comes back, or a chore that never stays done. Going round it once more costs your evening and some of your patience.
A younger person tests the same limit again, or a long plan sticks at its usual snag. Holding the line asks for a calm you have to find twice over.
Friction at work returns, the same complaint from the same quarter as before. Answering it again eats into hours you had planned for something new.
An old disagreement from your first home stirs again, over the same small point as before. Hearing it out once more draws on a patience your day had meant for other things.
Home repeats an old pattern, the same talk over dinner or the same small habit. Seeing it plainly asks you to decide which part you still want.
An old plan for later returns in nearly its first form, or a young person asks the same question twice. Each return asks for an answer clearer than your last one.
Work brings back a task you thought was finished, or a meeting that covers familiar points. Old steps take fresh hours, while your newer work waits behind them.
An old family story comes up again, told the way it always is. One part of it sounds different this time, and it points back at you.
The ties at home tighten this month, and a shared plan with a partner or the people you live with settles. Each evening brings you back to a calmer house.
Bonds with the people after you deepen this month, a child, a younger relative or someone you train. Small gestures of care pass between you, and they ask for your time in return.
Your place at work settles this month, and an agreement with a colleague or a client holds firm. Steadier support stands behind your tasks week by week.
The family you grew up in draws you back this month, through visits, old recipes or a shared decision. Ease with them returns after a long while, along with their claims on your time.
Your home life is shaken up this month, in the furniture, the plans or the shape of a shared week. Old habits with the people closest to you stop working, and new ones cost you effort to build.
Long plans come apart and take new shapes this month, while the young people around you change course. Some plans you counted on are lost along the way, and tracking the rest takes your attention.
A role or a routine you settled at work comes loose this month and has to be rebuilt in a new shape. The rebuilding costs you weeks of steady footing.
Something settled in the family you grew up in shifts this month, a role among siblings or who looks after whom. Your old place moves under you, and the new one is not yet clear.
Life at home gains strength this month, with a partner or the people you live with backing the same plan. The house pulls one way week by week, and your part in it grows.
Plans for later gather support this month, and young people around you bring fresh energy to them. A long project takes on weight, and its demands on your time grow with it.
Work builds speed this month, with new people joining and tasks falling into place. The momentum asks you to carry more than you had planned.
Your wider family pulls together this month around an event or a shared need. Their call on your strength comes often, and answering it fills your weekends.
Little misreadings gather at home this month, with a partner or the people you live with. Each one is small, though together they wear on your evenings.
This month a quiet gap opens between you and someone you teach or look after. Words do little to close it, and it asks for your time instead.
Small slights pile up at work this month, a credit not given or a message left unread. Keeping your own record straight costs you calm with each one.
A coolness creeps into the family you grew up in this month, from a word taken badly or a call left unreturned. The distance costs you the easy warmth of a usual call home.
An old sore point at home keeps returning this month, usually over who does what. Each round draws on your patience, and the weeks give little rest between them.
A long plan keeps catching on the same problem this month, while someone younger pushes against your rules. Your patience is tested week after week.
The same friction at work keeps coming back all month, a process that jams or a rule nobody likes. Working around it costs you effort every single week.
A family grievance from years back stays alive through this month, raised at each visit or call. Every mention reopens it, and its weight sits on you between calls.
No strong bond reaches your gates this time. What you meet comes from the energy above, at the pace it sets for you.
The day falls in your Void, a gap in your chart that opens two days in every twelve. Whatever you start today lands late or lighter than promised.
Today starts your next year of age. You carry the last one into it, what it taught you and what it cost.
Your next cycle of luck begins this year and runs ten years from this birthday. A different season of your life opens with it.
This birthday starts the next ten years of your life as one stretch. A fresh part of you comes into its own, carrying the years behind you.
A new month opens today, and the days that follow take their tone from it. Your pace shifts before you can say why.
A new year opens today, and its energy runs until next February. The turn reaches you before you can name it.
Today matches the day you were born on in the sixty-day count, as it does six times a year. Things you began in the last two months come back to you, clearer than before.
Today is your own day turned over, its stem at odds with yours and its branch clashing your Day Gate. Something settled at home is called into question, with you the one asked to answer for it.
